# artifactkeeper_totp_policy (Resource)

System-wide 2FA enforcement policy, a singleton (one instance regardless of how many times declared; delete is a no-op and doesn't reset the backend).

The policy is evaluated only on interactive local password login. API tokens, service accounts, package-client basic auth, existing sessions and SSO/LDAP users are all exempt, so turning it on does not break CI or a running `docker pull`. A user who has not enrolled is not locked out: their login returns an enrollment ticket instead of a session.

Two things make an apply fail with `409`, both deliberate: the `TOTP_POLICY` environment variable pins the policy (`editable` is then `false`), and **tightening** the policy requires the admin whose credentials the provider is using to have TOTP enrolled already. Relaxing is never refused. If the provider authenticates with `username`/`password` rather than a token, enabling this will also lock the provider itself out at the next login, so use a token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Require 2FA of every administrator with a local password. The admin whose
# credentials the provider uses must already have TOTP enrolled, or the apply
# fails with a 409.
resource "artifactkeeper_totp_policy" "this" {
  policy = "required_for_admins"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy` (String) `disabled` (TOTP stays opt-in, the backend default), `required_for_admins`, or `required_for_all` (every local user).

### Read-Only

- `editable` (Boolean) Whether the policy can be changed over the API. `false` when `source` is `environment`.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for the TOTP policy singleton (always `totp_policy`).
- `source` (String) Where the policy in force comes from: `database` (the stored setting, which this resource owns) or `environment` (`TOTP_POLICY` pins it and writes are refused).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artifactkeeper_totp_policy.this totp_policy
```
